title: Commands the wave fragments run
description: A workflow script cannot run Node, so every command in assets/wave-fragments/*.js runs inside an agent() call that returns $defs/runResult; the JSON the command prints on stdout must match the $defs entry named for it here. Defaults (each overridable through the fragment's input.commands): critique.mjs measure, critique.mjs ui-copy and critique.mjs --verify-receipt (feCritique and the FE-20 proof); board.mjs render, board.mjs screen and board.mjs board (feDirections). Restore uses plain git. Exit codes follow scripts/CONTRACTS.md section 1.

json.description: stdout parsed as JSON, or null when stdout is not one JSON object.

stderr_tail.description: Last lines of stderr, at most 2,000 characters.

failing.description: Ids of the gates that are fail or skipped (a skipped gate never counts as passing).

measure.description:
critique.mjs measure --round --label --profile

--state --root . : runs the --phase build gates on the served build, computes the deterministic sub-scores, writes DOM-marked viewport tiles at 1440x900 and 390x844 (DPR 2, animations disabled), the marks file, the binary checklist derived from the brief and the critic task file under /critique/round-/

sha.description: git HEAD of the measured tree.

ui_tree.description: git rev-parse HEAD:<ui_root>, which survives a rebase when nothing else touched the UI.

scores.description: Deterministic sub-scores, each higher-is-better (layout, typography, contrast margin, page economy, ...).

deterministic.description: Problems a deterministic check measured, tied to marks; they confirm a critic's issue on the same mark.

task_file.description: Critic task file for kind critique: tiles, marks, checklist, brief and the output format.

first_view.description: Viewport name to the path of its first-viewport image, unmarked, for the blind probes.

proposition.description: The brief's one-line proposition (brief.hero.h1 and brief.hero.sentence).

verifyReceipt.description: critique.mjs --verify-receipt <path> --root .: exit 0 only when the receipt validates against critique-receipt.schema.json, its checksum matches, ok is true and best.ui_tree equals git rev-parse HEAD:<ui_root>.

screen.description:
board.mjs screen --direction --generic /similar-prompt --state --profile

: the checker on the hero comp, the similar-prompt test (tokens identical to the generic plan) and the ledger of past directions.

board.description:
board.mjs board --state --profile

: the direction board the orchestrator publishes for H1.
